title: AI, Machine Learning and Agentic AI Fundamentals

header.html: 3. Innovating with Google Cloud artificial intelligence (about 18%)

3.1 Describe fundamental AI and ML concepts and how they create business value: define AI, ML, generative AI, data analytics and business intelligence; how agentic AI reshapes industries; the key benefits of Google Cloud's AI offerings; the business problems ML solves; why data quality matters and its dimensions; explainable and responsible AI
the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide

toc.title: Problems ML solves and its value

html:
1The vocabulary

Term Meaning
Artificial intelligence (AI) Systems that perform tasks that normally need human intelligence
Machine learning (ML) A part of AI where models learn patterns from data instead of following hand-written rules
Generative AI (gen AI) AI that creates new content: text, images, code, audio, video
Agentic AI AI agents that reason, plan, use tools and take actions to reach a goal
Data analytics Examining data to describe what happened and why
Business intelligence (BI) Reports and dashboards for decisions

AI and ML versus analytics and BI: analytics and BI explain the past and present with fixed queries and charts; ML predicts and classifies and gen AI creates; agents act.

Exam tip

. Analytics describes. ML predicts. Gen AI creates. Agentic AI acts.

2How agentic AI reshapes work

Area Example of agents helping
Workforce productivity Summarize meetings, draft documents, find company knowledge
Customer support Resolve questions, route cases, hand over to people
Sales experiences Personalize offers, prepare account research
Product innovation Test ideas, generate designs and code
Operations Automate routine workflows and approvals
Research Search and synthesize large collections of material

Benefits of Google Cloud's AI offerings: best infrastructure for AI, an AI-ready data cloud, sophisticated first-party models (Gemini), an all-in-one AI developer platform and pre-built AI agents and applications.

3Problems ML solves and its value

Business problem ML value
Replace or simplify rule-based systems A model learns the rules from data and adapts
Derive insight from large datasets Find patterns humans would miss, in structured and unstructured data
Scale business decisions Make millions of decisions consistently (credit, fraud, recommendations)

Typical ML tasks: classification (spam or not), prediction (demand), recommendation, anomaly detection, vision, speech and language understanding.

4Data quality

A model is only as good as its data: garbage in, garbage out.

Dimension Question
Completeness Is all the needed data present?
Uniqueness Are there no duplicates?
Timeliness Is the data recent enough?
Validity Does it follow the required format and rules?
Accuracy Is it correct?
Consistency Is it the same across systems?

5Explainable and responsible AI

Idea Business meaning
Explainable AI People can understand why a model gave a result, which builds trust and helps audits and regulation
Responsible AI Fairness, safety, privacy, security and accountability; Google applies AI principles
Business implications Reduces bias and legal risk, protects reputation, earns customer trust
Exam tip

. Poor or biased data gives poor or biased results. Explainability builds trust, and trust enables adoption.

Exam tip

. Check the data first. If a model gives poor results, the exam answer is usually better, cleaner, more representative data, not a bigger model.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A marketing team wants to produce draft product descriptions and images automatically. Which technology fits?

  • AGenerative AI that creates new content
  • BBusiness intelligence dashboards
  • CA relational database of products and prices
  • DA data lake of historical sales
Show the answer

Answer: A. Generative AI creates new content such as text and images.

S2A customer support assistant plans several steps, uses company tools and resolves a request without a person. What is this?

  • AAgentic AI that reasons and acts toward a goal
  • BA data warehouse that stores support cases for reports
  • CA dashboard that shows weekly ticket counts
  • DA load balancer that routes incoming calls
Show the answer

Answer: A. Agentic AI uses agents that reason, plan and act to reach a goal.

S3A lender replaces many hand-written credit rules with a model that learns from past loans. Which business value is this?

  • AReducing the cost of office space
  • BCreating a multicloud network
  • CMoving a database to object storage
  • DReplacing or simplifying rule-based systems
Show the answer

Answer: D. ML can learn patterns from data and replace complex hand-written rules.

S4A model trained on customer records performs badly because many records are duplicated. Which data quality dimension is the problem?

  • ATimeliness, since the data is quite old and stale
  • BValidity, since formats are wrong
  • CUniqueness, since records are duplicated
  • DConsistency, since systems disagree
Show the answer

Answer: C. Duplicate records are a uniqueness problem.

S5A regulator asks a bank why its model rejected a loan. Which concept helps the bank answer?

  • AAutoscaling of compute resources
  • BExplainable AI that shows why a result occurred
  • CStreaming ingestion of events
  • DData lakes for unstructured files
Show the answer

Answer: B. Explainable AI helps people understand why a model gave a result.

S6Which statement best separates ML from business intelligence?

  • AML learns patterns to predict while BI explains data with reports
  • BBI creates new images while ML builds dashboards
  • CBI and ML are the same and give identical output
  • DML only stores data while BI processes it
Show the answer

Answer: A. BI reports on data with fixed queries; ML learns patterns to predict or classify.

6.2 Recall questions

R1What does generative AI do?

Show the answer

Creates new content.

R2What is agentic AI?

Show the answer

AI agents that reason, plan and act toward goals.

R3Name three data quality dimensions.

Show the answer

For example completeness, accuracy and timeliness.

R4What does explainable AI provide?

Show the answer

Understanding of why a model gave a result.

R5Is ML part of AI?

Show the answer

Yes, ML is a part of AI.

R6Name one business problem ML solves.

Show the answer

For example scaling business decisions.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Terms AI contains ML, which contains gen AI; agentic AI acts; analytics and BI describe
Value replace rules, find patterns, scale decisions
Data quality completeness, uniqueness, timeliness, validity, accuracy, consistency
Responsible AI explainable, fair, safe, private, accountable
